sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION Our
historical net tangible book value as of June 30, 2026 was approximately US$29.419 million, or US$1.80 per ordinary share. Net tangible
book value is total assets less total liabilities, intangible assets and goodwill. Net tangible book value per ordinary share is net
tangible book value divided by the aggregate number of Class A and Class B ordinary shares outstanding, which have the same economic
rights except as described under “Description of Securities We Are Offering.” Our calculation deducts US$30.665 million of
intangible assets, net, and US$0.791 million of goodwill from reported shareholders’ equity of US$60.875 million and uses 16,216,825
Class A and 110,000 Class B ordinary shares outstanding at June 30, 2026, or 16,326,825 ordinary shares in total. These historical figures
already reflect the March 2025 reverse split. Our
